name: CreateCopilotSession

parameters.help_en: The session name. The name must be 1 to 255 characters in length. Default value: New Session. Empty strings or null values are not supported. If no name is specified, the server uses content generation to generate a session name based on the first user message when it is received
parameters.help_zh: 会话名称。长度为 1～255 个字符。默认值为 New Session。不支持空字符串或 null。未指定名称时，服务端在受理首条用户消息时，根据消息内容生成会话名称
parameters.name: name

scheduledTask.description_en: The information about the associated scheduled task

runId.description_zh: 本次调度执行的 ID，用于区分同一定时任务的不同触发记录

timezone.description_en: The scheduling time zone of the scheduled task

sessionId.description_zh: 会话 ID。后续发送消息、查询、更新或删除会话时使用该值

sessionType.description_en:
The session source. Valid values:
openapi: API call.
cron: scheduled task.
im_dingtalk: DingTalk.
im_feishu: Lark.
alert: alert.
Sessions created by this operation are of the openapi type
sessionType.description_zh: 会话来源。取值：openapi，主动调用；cron，定时任务；im_dingtalk，钉钉；im_feishu，飞书；alert，告警。本接口创建的会话为 openapi

status.description_en: The session status. The session created by this operation is active, which indicates that the session is available for use, but does not indicate that the agent is executing a task
status.description_zh: 会话状态。本接口创建的会话为 active，表示会话可使用，不表示 Agent 正在执行任务

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the session was updated

message.description_en:
The error message.

message.description_zh:
